rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that stands out visually, whether attractively or conspicuously.

example.english: This orange coat is really showy; you notice it as soon as you walk in.

rows.note: Use this for a richly beautiful or ornate visual display, such as flowers, clothing, or decoration.

example.english: The showy decorations on the stage made the whole performance more grand.

rows.note: Use this when the showiness is excessive, ostentatious, or deliberately attention-seeking rather than simply attractive.

example.english: Their proposal was so showy that the whole street knew.
